<\STATESEP>chapter \<open>\label{h:abbreviations}Convenience Definitions\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Abbreviations
imports Types
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:componentlocal}Local Component Operations\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:univc}UNIV$_c$\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  UNIV\<^sub>c :: "'component_state local_state set"
where
  "UNIV\<^sub>c \<equiv> {x. case x of Component _ \<Rightarrow> True | _ \<Rightarrow> False}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:internal}Internal Step\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  internal :: "'component_state local_state \<Rightarrow>
    'component_state local_state set"
where
  "internal s \<equiv> case s of Component _ \<Rightarrow> UNIV\<^sub>c | _ \<Rightarrow> {}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:userstep}User Steps\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  UserStep :: "('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "UserStep \<equiv> LocalOp internal"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:componentcommunication}Communication Component Operations\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:discard}Discard Messages\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  discard :: "'channel answer \<Rightarrow> 'component_state local_state \<Rightarrow>
    'component_state local_state set"
where
  "discard a s \<equiv> if a_data a = Void then {s} else {}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:arbitraryrequest}Arbitrary Requests\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  ArbitraryRequest :: "'channel \<Rightarrow> ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "ArbitraryRequest c \<equiv> Request (\<lambda>_. {x. q_channel x = c}) (\<lambda>_ _. UNIV\<^sub>c)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:arbitraryresponse}Arbitrary Responses\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  ArbitraryResponse :: "'channel \<Rightarrow> ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "ArbitraryResponse c \<equiv>
    Response (\<lambda>_ _. {(s',\<beta>). s' \<in> UNIV\<^sub>c \<and> a_channel \<beta> = c})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:eventemit}Event Emit\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  EventEmit :: "'channel \<Rightarrow> ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "EventEmit c \<equiv> Request (\<lambda>s. {\<lparr>q_channel = c, q_data = Set\<rparr>}) discard"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:eventpoll}Event Poll\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  EventPoll :: "'channel \<Rightarrow>
    ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'component_state local_state) \<Rightarrow>
    ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "EventPoll c embed_data \<equiv>
    Request (\<lambda>_. {\<lparr>q_channel = c, q_data = Poll\<rparr>})
            (\<lambda>a s. case a_data a of Pending b \<Rightarrow> {embed_data s b} | _ \<Rightarrow> {})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:eventwait}Event Wait\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  EventWait :: "'channel \<Rightarrow>
    ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> bool \<Rightarrow> 'component_state local_state) \<Rightarrow>
    ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "EventWait c embed_data \<equiv>
    Request (\<lambda>_. {\<lparr>q_channel = c, q_data = Poll\<rparr>})
            (\<lambda>a s. case a_data a of Pending b \<Rightarrow> if b then {embed_data s b} else {}
                                  | _ \<Rightarrow> {})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:memoryread}Memory Read\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  MemoryRead :: "'channel \<Rightarrow>
    ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
    ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> variable \<Rightarrow> 'component_state local_state) \<Rightarrow>
    ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "MemoryRead c addr embed_data \<equiv>
    Request (\<lambda>s. {\<lparr>q_channel = c, q_data = Read (addr s)\<rparr>})
            (\<lambda>a s. case a_data a of Value v \<Rightarrow> {embed_data s v} | _ \<Rightarrow> {})"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:memorywrite}Memory Write\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  MemoryWrite :: "'channel \<Rightarrow> ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> nat) \<Rightarrow>
    ('component_state local_state \<Rightarrow> variable) \<Rightarrow>
    ('channel, 'component_state) comp"
where
  "MemoryWrite c addr val \<equiv>
    Request (\<lambda>s. {\<lparr>q_channel = c, q_data = Write (addr s) (val s)\<rparr>}) discard"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
